summary.name: Quick Note
summary.one_liner: Quick Note is a macOS sticky-notes app that lives in the menu bar and opens notes via a global shortcut, keeping them floating above other windows.
use_cases: capture a quick thought without opening a notes app
keep a phone number or reminder visible above other windows
keep notes synced across multiple Macs
summary.what_it_does: Quick Note creates sticky notes accessible from the menu bar, a global shortcut, a desktop widget, the Shortcuts app, the Services menu, AppleScript and Terminal. Notes can float on top of all other apps and each note can be given its own color. The editor supports headings, bold, highlight, checklists and links, all driven by keyboard shortcuts such as ⌘B for bold and ⇧⌘L for checklist. Notes can be backed up and synced through iCloud in the PRO version.
notable: Menu bar, global shortcut, Shortcuts app, AppleScript and Terminal integration
Notes float on top of other windows; per-note colors
Keyboard-driven rich text formatting including checklists and highlight
caveats: Free trial limited to 30 days and up to 6 notes
iCloud sync and unlimited notes require the one-time PRO purchase
